title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Fair to write something like “most signs are pointing to Boyd staying put”? Gotta wrote a story on why it makes sense to keep him
Don’t go over board though because something can come together at the end. This looks like a bluff who blinks first deadline.
I didn’t, I just wrote you guys have time on your side so you shouldn’t lower asking price.
